prompt: An antiproton is the anti-particle of the proton. It has the same mass as a proton, but has a charge of -1.60 x 10-19 C and is made of antimatter. Whenever matter and antimatter come into contact they will annihilate and convert 100% of their mass into energy. If 881 protons collided with an equal number of antiprotons, the total energy released would be _____ GeV.
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 correctly applies mass–energy conversion using the proton rest energy in GeV and properly multiplies by 881 protons and 881 antiprotons, yielding ≈1653 GeV. Candidate 2 makes a clear conversion/multiplication error and ends far from the correct value. Candidates 3 and 4 follow the right approach but contain arithmetic/approximation mistakes that shift the final totals by several GeV.
